works.request: Timber-look or vinyl flooring in the living room and bedrooms (boards 1, 2 and 3)
works.reason: Overlaying floor finishes in dry areas is generally allowed without a permit if the existing floor is not hacked. Use an HDB-registered contractor. works.request: Light stone-look floor tiles in the living room (board 4)
works.reason: Allowed as an overlay on the existing dry-area floor, within HDB's floor finish thickness limit. Hacking the existing floor would need a permit through an HDB-registered contractor. This is an alternative to timber-look flooring, so see the questions.

works.request: Vertical timber slat feature wall behind the bed (board 3)
works.reason: Non-structural carpentry fixed to the wall surface is generally allowed. Do not hack or chase structural walls, and do not cover the DB box or service access points.

works.request: Warm white and off-white wall paint throughout
works.reason: Internal repainting needs no HDB permit.

works.request: Curved false ceiling or cove (board 4)
works.reason: A lightweight false ceiling is allowed if it is suspended below the existing slab, with no hacking of the ceiling or beams. Keep the required minimum ceiling height and leave access to any services.

works.request: Large circular window in the external wall (board 2)
works.reason: This means cutting or changing the opening in an external wall, which changes the building facade and possibly the structure. HDB does not permit it. A circular timber or plaster frame on the inside, around the existing window, could give a similar look.

works.request: Curved full-height glazing replacing the external wall (board 4)
works.reason: HDB does not permit removing or enlarging external walls and window openings. Floor-to-ceiling sheer curtains over the existing wall and windows give a similar look.

works.request: Internal staircase (board 4)
works.reason: A staircase to another level would need an opening through the structural floor slab, which is not permitted in an HDB flat. Timber wall panelling could echo the material.

works.request: Full-height sheer curtains and roller blinds (boards 3 and 4)
works.reason: Soft furnishings and tracks fixed to the wall or ceiling surface need no permit.

works.request: Pendant lights and wall sconces, including new lighting points (boards 1, 3 and 4)
works.reason: No HDB permit is needed for lighting. New wiring must be done by a licensed electrician, without hacking the ceiling slab or structural walls.

works.request: Wall-mounted air-conditioning unit in the bedroom (board 3)
works.reason: Allowed when installed by a qualified contractor, with the condenser in the designated location such as the air-con ledge. It must not be fixed to the facade elsewhere.

works.request: Dark timber finish on the bedroom door (board 3)
works.reason: Laminating or replacing an internal bedroom door is generally allowed. This does not cover the main door, which has separate fire-rating and appearance requirements.
